environment.description: Same Apollo Server deployment on ECS Fargate, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The ACL includes a custom rule group with priority 1 that inspects the request JSON body (oversize handling: CONTINUE) using a regex pattern set matching field names associated with privilege attributes in the request body. Specifically, a RegexPatternSet with patterns '"(role|isAdmin|is_admin|admin|privilege|apiQuota|permissions)"\s*:' is applied via a JsonBody match statement scoped to ALL content. The rule action is BLOCK with a 403 response. Additionally, the ACL has AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY limiting body to 8KB. The WAF is configured with CloudWatch metrics and sampled requests enabled for audit. Note: the custom regex rule inspects the FULL parsed JSON body, not just the GraphQL 'query' field - it scans the entire POST body including variables.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL association
config.network: VPC with public ALB (WAF-protected), private subnets for ECS tasks
